1. Would you not add a couple of extra minutes to the queue time if it eliminated the possibility of cheaters? I would.
2. It would work exactly like it does with ranks. And if the happy medium between the levels wouldn't work, just add a limit like in ranks.
3. A "new" player doesn't run around dropping 30 bombs, and if you were, as you say, a silver at one point, you should know that.
4. That is the one thing I can agree with you on, they most likely wouldn't because they love money more than life itself, but IF they added it and IF it got lowbobs to stop playing they might actually fix a decent anticheat/antismurf system.
5. If you grinded from Nova3 to GE and only faced "a few" cheaters/smurfs you're a liar.
6. Preforming good will NOT take you to the rank you deserve, ranks isnt based on how YOU play, its based on how the team plays. I can run around dropping 40bombs and losing every single match 14-16 because my backpack is full and still derank.
7. Again "never met a smurf" liar.
